ui.lyrics.historyOnly: 有逐字时间时，当前行已唱字词累积保留，未唱文字完全隐藏；只有整句时间时，提示后自动显示当前整行。换行保持原位置。
With word timing, retain the sung prefix and completely hide unsung text. With line timing only, notify and show the current full line. Line changes keep the same position.
ui.lyrics.futurePreviewHint: 有逐字时间时，当前行已唱字词累积保留，未唱文字完全隐藏；只有整句时间时，提示后自动显示当前整行。换行保持原位置。
With word timing, retain the sung prefix and completely hide unsung text. With line timing only, notify and show the current full line. Line changes keep the same position.
ui.lyrics.lineTiming: 平台仅提供整句时间，已自动切换为整行显示，不推测逐字进度。
The platform provides line timing only. Full-line display is enabled automatically; word progress is not guessed.
ui.lyrics.wordTiming: 平台提供逐字／词时间：按实际开始时间逐步增加当前行的字词，已经唱过的部分保留。
Native character or word timing is available. Add each unit at its actual start and retain the sung part of the current line.
ui.lyrics.segmentTiming: 平台分段时间较粗：单字或词按起始时间加入，多个字词的整段等确认唱完后加入；不估算逐字时间。
Coarse segment timing is available. Add individual units at their start; wait for multiword segments to finish. Never estimate character timing.
ui.lyrics.translationTimingHint: 译文按平台时间显示：有逐字时间时累积已唱部分，只有整句时间时按整行显示。缺少译文时不自动生成。
Translations use platform timing: accumulate the sung prefix with word timing, or show the full line with line timing only. Never generate missing translations.
ui.lyrics.lineModeTitle: 歌词已切换为整行显示
ui.lyrics.lineModeDetail: 平台仅提供整句时间，已显示当前整行；遇到逐字歌词会自动恢复逐字累计。
Only line timing is available, so the current full line is shown. Word-timed lyrics automatically return to cumulative word display.
